infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Bidar Connect needs your location to track live journey progress along the NH 65 corridor and broadcast emergency SOS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Background location is required for driver partners to broadcast highway trip progress to passengers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera access is needed to scan digital ticket QR passes and upload KYC documentation.
